b: Universal Pictures has released the trailer for The Comeback King, Judd Apatow’s first fiction feature since 2022’s Hollywood satire The Bubble. The film stars Glen Powell as Aubrey King, a hot-shot country star whose songs about drinkin’ and lovin’ have made him famous but left him feeling like a commodity. When he learns that his girlfriend, pop superstar Missy (Madelyn Cline), hasn’t been faithful and breaks things off, she strikes back with a track that paints him as the cheater, sending his career into a tailspin.

Forced to lie low, Aubrey heads back to college to finish his degree, where a no-nonsense professor played by Cristin Milioti is less than impressed by the celebrity in her classroom. Apatow wrote the film’s script with Powell, who previously shared screenplay credit with Richard Linklater on Hit Man, and Powell trained in guitar and singing to perform a batch of original songs penned by some of Nashville’s top songwriters.

Stavros Halkias co-stars as Aubrey’s unconventional manager and Li Jin Hao as his roommate, with a supporting cast that includes Leanne Morgan, Kumail Nanjiani, Vanessa Bayer, Atsuko Okatsuka, Tig Notaro, Chris Fleming, Mike Birbiglia, and Big Fella. Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley, Miranda Lambert, Shaboozey, Chris Stapleton, Brandi Carlile, Luke Bryan, and Reba McEntire also make appearances. Kevin Misher, Apatow, Powell, and Dan Cohen produced.
The Comeback King opens in theaters on February 5.
